groups[].population_size.definition: Number of users in the group, as written in the tab row labelled as a user count (e.g. "Unique Users (unormalized)") for the same block as the metric row. Integer parsed from the cell text; not normalised.
groups[].population_size.source: results tab cell named in groups[].population_size_cell

groups[].population_size_raw.definition: The group-size cell text exactly as shown in the tab.

groups[].population_size_cell.definition: A1 cell of the group size in the tab (same tab as source.tab).

groups[].population_size_label.definition: Row label of the group-size cell as written in the tab.
groups[].population_size_label.source: results tab, column A of the group-size row

uncertainty.p_value.definition: Value in the tab column headed P-value / P-Value for this metric row, as a number. Meaning as labelled by the tab author; test type not documented in the tab.

uncertainty.p_value_raw / p_value_cell /.definition: Cell text, A1 cell and column header of the p-value.

uncertainty.ci.definition: Uncertainty range [low, high] in % when the tab shows a range. Null when the tab shows no range (a single value in a CI column is kept only in ci_raw).

uncertainty.ci_raw / ci_cell / ci_header.definition: Text, A1 cell and header of the tab CI column for this row, as written.
uncertainty.ci_raw / ci_cell / ci_header.question: DOM-1550 L4 'CI' = '90%': is this a confidence level, a probability to beat control, or something else?

uncertainty.significance.definition: Significance flag/text exactly as the tab states it (e.g. "significant"). Never derived from p_value by us.

uncertainty.checked_at.definition: Date the tab was re-read for population/uncertainty cells.
